title: CMC Markets Prepares Prop Trading Launch as LCG Finalizes Buyout
summary: The retail trading sector witnessed significant strategic shifts this week, highlighted by CMC Markets preparing a simulated proprietary trading launch. LCG also concluded a multi-year buyout process, while regulators continued scrutinizing CFD providers with overseas links. Meanwhile, traditional brokers keep diversifying into new revenue streams such as crypto operations and proprietary trading frameworks.
body:
The retail forex and CFD industry experienced another eventful week characterized by major corporate developments, regulatory oversight, and strategic product expansions. Major legacy brokers are actively exploring new business lines to capture shifting trader demands and evolving market conditions across global financial hubs.

One of the most notable announcements came from CMC Markets, which is gearing up to introduce a simulated proprietary trading service. This move highlights the growing trend of traditional brokers entering the funded trader ecosystem, offering retail traders structured evaluation programs similar to independent prop firms.

In corporate news, London Capital Group (LCG) officially finalized its complex three-year buyout process. The resolution provides the broker with renewed operational stability and allows leadership to refocus on expanding its core retail and institutional product offerings in a competitive market environment.

Regulatory scrutiny remained firmly in focus, particularly in the United Kingdom. The Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) took additional enforcement steps against various CFD providers associated with complex overseas operational structures, reinforcing compliance standards for firms serving domestic clients.

Brokers are also adapting their technological infrastructure and expanding into adjacent sectors. eToro advanced its client transition toward an artificial intelligence-centric trading application, while Capital.com laid groundwork for a dedicated UK digital asset operation.

However, market headwinds continue to impact some industry participants. BlackBull Markets opted to postpone its initial public offering plans, and iFOREX released financial results revealing a net loss for the first half of the year.

These developments underline an industry in transition, where traditional brokers must balance regulatory pressures with rapid innovation. As more established entities launch proprietary trading initiatives, retail traders can expect even greater integration between standard brokerage accounts and funded trading models.
sourceName: Retail FX – Finance Magnates | Financial and business news

es.title: CMC Markets prepara el lanzamiento de trading de cuentas funded mientras LCG finaliza su compra
es.summary: El sector del trading minorista experimentó importantes cambios estratégicos esta semana, destacados por CMC Markets preparándose para lanzar un servicio de prop trading simulado. LCG también concluyó un proceso de compra plurianual, mientras los reguladores continúan escrutando a los proveedores de CFD con vínculos en el extranjero. Mientras tanto, los brokers tradicionales siguen diversificándose hacia nuevas fuentes de ingresos.
es.content:
La industria del forex minorista y de los CFD vivió otra semana llena de acontecimientos, caracterizada por importantes desarrollos corporativos, supervisión regulatoria y expansiones estratégicas de productos. Los principales brokers tradicionales están explorando activamente nuevas líneas de negocio para captar la cambiante demanda de los traders y las condiciones del mercado.

Uno de los anuncios más notables provino de CMC Markets, que se está preparando para introducir un servicio de trading por cuenta propia simulado. Este movimiento destaca la creciente tendencia de los brokers tradicionales a ingresar al ecosistema de traders financiados, ofreciendo programas estructurados similares a las firmas de prop trading independientes.

En noticias corporativas, London Capital Group (LCG) finalizó oficialmente su complejo proceso de adquisición de tres años. La resolución brinda al broker una estabilidad operativa renovada y permite a los líderes reenfocarse en expandir su oferta de productos minoristas e institucionales en un entorno competitivo.

El escrutinio regulatorio se mantuvo firmemente en el punto de mira, particularmente en el Reino Unido. La Autoridad de Conducta Financiera (FCA) tomó medidas adicionales de cumplimiento contra varios proveedores de CFD asociados con complejas estructuras operativas en el extranjero.

Los brokers también están adaptando su infraestructura tecnológica y expandiéndose a sectores adyacentes. eToro avanzó en su transición de clientes hacia una aplicación de trading centrada en inteligencia artificial, mientras que Capital.com sentó las bases para una operación de activos digitales en el Reino Unido.

Sin embargo, los vientos en contra del mercado continúan afectando a algunos participantes de la industria. BlackBull Markets optó por posponer sus planes de oferta pública inicial e iFOREX publicó resultados financieros que revelan una pérdida neta en el primer semestre del año.

Estos acontecimientos subrayan una industria en transición, donde los brokers tradicionales deben equilibrar las presiones regulatorias con la rápida innovación. A medida que más entidades consolidadas lanzan iniciativas de prop trading, los traders pueden esperar una mayor integración entre cuentas estándar y modelos de fondeo.

cn.title: CMC Markets 准备推出自营交易业务，LCG 完成收购
cn.summary: 本周零售交易行业经历了显著的战略转变，其中最引人注目的是 CMC Markets 正在筹备模拟自营交易服务。同时，LCG 完成了多年收购流程，而监管机构继续审查与海外有关联的 CFD 提供商。与此同时，传统经纪商正不断向加密货币业务和自营交易框架等新收入来源多元化发展。
cn.content:
零售外汇和差价合约（CFD）行业迎来了又一个多事之周，主要特征是重大企业动态、监管监督以及战略产品扩张。各大传统经纪商正在积极探索新的业务线，以捕捉全球金融中心不断变化的交易者需求和市场状况。

最引人注目的公告之一来自 CMC Markets，该公司正准备引入模拟自营交易服务。此举突显了传统经纪商进军资管交易员生态系统的不断增长的趋势，为零售交易者提供类似于独立自营公司的结构化评估计划。

在企业新闻方面，伦敦资本集团（LCG）正式完成了其复杂的三年期收购流程。这一决议为该经纪商提供了更新的运营稳定性，并使管理层能够在竞争激烈的市场环境中重新专注于扩大其核心零售和机构产品。

监管审查仍然是关注的焦点，特别是在英国。金融行为监管局（FCA）对与复杂海外运营结构相关的各种 CFD 提供商采取了进一步的执法步骤，加强了为国内客户服务的公司的合规标准。

经纪商还在调整其技术基础设施并向相邻领域扩张。eToro 推进了其向以人工智能为中心的交易应用程序的客户过渡，而 Capital.com 为英国专门的数字资产业务奠定了基础。

然而，市场逆风继续影响着一些行业参与者。BlackBull Markets 选择推迟其首次公开募股计划，iFOREX 公布的财务业绩显示上半年出现净亏损。

这些发展突显了一个处于转型期行业，传统经纪商必须平衡监管压力与快速创新。随着越来越多的老牌实体推出自营交易计划，零售交易者可以期待标准经纪账户与资管交易模型之间实现更大的融合。

tw.title: CMC Markets 準備推出自營交易服務，LCG 完成收購案
tw.summary: 本週零售交易產業迎來了顯著的戰略轉變，其中以 CMC Markets 籌備模擬自營交易服務最受關注。同時，LCG 完成了多年的收購流程，而監管機構持續審查與海外有關聯的 CFD 提供商。傳統經紀商也持續拓展如加密貨幣與自營交易等新營收來源。
tw.content:
零售外匯與差價契約（CFD）產業經歷了充滿變動的一週，重大企業動態、監管審查與戰略產品擴張成為市場焦點。各大傳統經紀商正積極開拓新業務領域，以因應全球金融中心不斷變化的交易需求與市場環境。

其中一項最受矚目的公告來自 CMC Markets，該公司正積極籌備推出模擬自營交易服務。這項舉措凸顯出傳統經紀商進一步打入資管交易員生態系統的趨勢，為零售交易員提供類似於獨立自營商的結構化評估計劃。

在企業消息方面，倫敦資本集團（LCG）正式敲定其長達三年的複雜收購流程。這項決議為該經紀商帶來了全新的營運穩定性，並讓管理階層能夠在競爭激烈的市場環境中，重新聚焦於擴展其核心零售與機構產品線。

監管審查依然是市場焦點，特別是在英國。金融行為監管局（FCA）針對與複雜海外營運架構有關的各家 CFD 提供商採取了進一步的執法行動，藉此強化服務本土客戶之企業的合規標準。

經紀商同時也在調整其技術基礎設施並拓展至相鄰產業。eToro 推進了其朝向以人工智慧為核心的交易應用程式之客戶過渡期，而 Capital.com 則為其專屬的英國數位資產業務奠定基礎。

不過，市場逆風仍持續影響部分產業參與者。BlackBull Markets 選擇延後首次公開募股（IPO）計劃，iFOREX 發布的財務報告也顯示其上半年出現淨損。

這些發展凸顯出正處於轉型期的產業現況，傳統經紀商必須在監管壓力與快速創新之間取得平衡。隨著更多老牌機構推出自營交易計畫，零售交易員未來有望看到標準經紀帳戶與資管交易模式更深度的整合。

th.title: CMC Markets เตรียมเปิดตัวบริการ Prop Trading พร้อมกับ LCG ที่ปิดดีลซื้อกิจการสำเร็จ
th.summary: ภาคการซื้อขายลูกค้ารายย่อยเผชิญกับการเปลี่ยนแปลงเชิงกลยุทธ์ครั้งใหญ่ในสัปดาห์นี้ โดยมีไฮไลต์ที่ CMC Markets เตรียมเปิดตัวบริการเทรดแบบจำลอง Prop Trading นอกจากนี้ LCG ยังปิดดีลซื้อกิจการหลายปีได้สำเร็จ ในขณะที่หน่วยงานกำกับดูแลยังคงตรวจสอบผู้ให้บริการ CFD ที่มีเครือข่ายต่างประเทศอย่างต่อเนื่อง
th.content:
อุตสาหกรรมฟอเร็กซ์และ CFD รายย่อยผ่านพ้นสัปดาห์ที่เต็มไปด้วยความเคลื่อนไหวสำคัญ ทั้งในด้านการพัฒนาองค์กร การกำกับดูแล และการขยายผลิตภัณฑ์เชิงกลยุทธ์ โบรกเกอร์รายใหญ่ต่างสำรวจช่องทางธุรกิจใหม่ๆ เพื่อตอบสนองความต้องการของเทรดเดอร์ที่เปลี่ยนแปลงไป

หนึ่งในประกาศที่น่าสนใจที่สุดมาจาก CMC Markets ซึ่งกำลังเตรียมเปิดตัวบริการซื้อขายพรอพปรัยเอทรีเทรดดิ้งแบบจำลอง ความเคลื่อนไหวนี้ตอกย้ำเทรนด์การเข้าสู่ระบบนิเวศเทรดเดอร์ฟันด์ของโบรกเกอร์ดั้งเดิม

ในส่วนของข่าวองค์กร London Capital Group (LCG) ได้สรุปกระบวนการซื้อกิจการที่ซับซ้อนยาวนานสามปีอย่างเป็นทางการ ซึ่งช่วยสร้างเสถียรภาพในการดำเนินงานให้กับบริษัท

การตรวจสอบจากหน่วยงานกำกับดูแลยังคงเข้มข้น โดยเฉพาะในสหราชอาณาจักร ที่ซึ่ง Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) ดำเนินมาตรการบังคับใช้กฎหมายเพิ่มเติมกับผู้ให้บริการ CFD ที่มีโครงสร้างต่างประเทศ

โบรกเกอร์ยังคงปรับโครงสร้างพื้นฐานทางเทคโนโลยี โดย eToro เดินหน้าเปลี่ยนผ่านไปสู่แอปพลิเคชันเทรดที่ขับเคลื่อนด้วย AI ขณะที่ Capital.com เตรียมดำเนินธุรกิจสินทรัพย์ดิจิทัลใน UK

อย่างไรก็ตาม ปัจจัยลบในตลาดยังคงส่งผลกระทบต่อผู้เล่นบางราย โดย BlackBull Markets ชะลอแผน IPO ขณะที่ iFOREX รายงานผลประกอบการขาดทุนสุทธิในครึ่งปีแรก

พัฒนาการเหล่านี้ตอกย้ำว่าอุตสาหกรรมกำลังอยู่ในช่วงเปลี่ยนผ่าน โบรกเกอร์จำเป็นต้องสร้างสมดุลระหว่างแรงกดดันด้านกฎระเบียบและนวัตกรรมใหม่ๆ

vi.title: CMC Markets chuẩn bị ra mắt giao dịch quỹ trong khi LCG hoàn tất thâu tóm
vi.summary: Ngành giao dịch bán lẻ chứng kiến những bước ngoặt chiến lược trong tuần này, nổi bật là việc CMC Markets chuẩn bị ra mắt dịch vụ giao dịch quỹ giả lập. LCG cũng hoàn tất quá trình thâu tóm kéo dài nhiều năm, trong khi các cơ quan quản lý tiếp tục siết chặt các nhà cung cấp CFD có liên kết quốc tế.
vi.content:
Thị trường ngoại hối và CFD bán lẻ đã trải qua một tuần sôi động với nhiều diễn biến doanh nghiệp lớn, sự giám sát quản lý và các đợt mở rộng sản phẩm chiến lược. Các nhà môi giới lâu đời đang tích cực khám phá các mảng kinh doanh mới để đáp ứng nhu cầu thay đổi của nhà giao dịch.

Một trong những thông báo đáng chú ý nhất đến từ CMC Markets, đơn vị đang chuẩn bị giới thiệu dịch vụ giao dịch quỹ độc quyền giả lập. Động thái này nhấn mạnh xu hướng ngày càng tăng của các nhà môi giới truyền thống khi gia nhập hệ sinh thái giao dịch được cấp quỹ.

Về mặt tin tức doanh nghiệp, London Capital Group (LCG) đã chính thức hoàn tất quá trình mua lại phức tạp kéo dài ba năm. Quyết định này mang lại sự ổn định hoạt động mới cho nhà môi giới.

Sự giám sát quản lý vẫn là tâm điểm, đặc biệt là tại Vương quốc Anh. Cơ quan Quản lý Tài chính (FCA) đã thực hiện các bước thực thi bổ sung đối với các nhà cung cấp CFD liên quan đến cấu trúc hoạt động ở nước ngoài.

Các nhà môi giới cũng đang điều chỉnh cơ sở hạ tầng công nghệ và mở rộng sang các lĩnh vực lân cận. eToro tiếp tục thúc đẩy quá trình chuyển đổi ứng dụng giao dịch tập trung vào trí tuệ nhân tạo.

Tuy nhiên, những trở ngại từ thị trường vẫn tiếp tục ảnh hưởng đến một số thành viên trong ngành. BlackBull Markets đã chọn hoãn kế hoạch phát hành cổ phiếu lần đầu ra công chúng (IPO).

Những diễn biến này nhấn mạnh một ngành công nghiệp đang trong giai đoạn chuyển đổi, nơi các nhà môi giới truyền thống phải cân bằng giữa áp lực quản lý và sự đổi mới nhanh chóng.

pt.title: CMC Markets prepara lançamento de prop trading enquanto LCG finaliza aquisição
pt.summary: O setor de varejo de trading testemunhou mudanças estratégicas significativas esta semana, destacadas pelo CMC Markets preparando o lançamento de um serviço de prop trading simulado. A LCG também concluiu um processo de aquisição plurianual, enquanto os reguladores continuam a examinar provedores de CFD com vínculos internacionais.
pt.content:
A indústria de forex de varejo e CFDs passou por outra semana agitada, caracterizada por importantes desenvolvimentos corporativos, supervisão regulatória e expansões estratégicas de produtos. Grandes corretoras tradicionais estão explorando ativamente novas linhas de negócios para capturar as demandas mutáveis dos traders e as condições de mercado em constante evolução.

Um dos anúncios mais notáveis veio do CMC Markets, que está se preparando para introduzir um serviço de simulação de prop trading. Esse movimento destaca a tendência crescente de corretoras tradicionais entrarem no ecossistema de traders financiados, oferecendo aos traders de varejo programas de avaliação estruturados semelhantes a mesas proprietárias independentes.

Em notícias corporativas, o London Capital Group (LCG) finalizou oficialmente seu complexo processo de aquisição de três anos. A resolução oferece à corretora estabilidade operacional renovada e permite que a liderança volte a focar na expansão de suas ofertas de produtos de varejo e institucionais em um ambiente competitivo.

O escrutínio regulatório permaneceu firmemente em foco, particularmente no Reino Unido. A Autoridade de Conduta Financeira (FCA) tomou medidas adicionais de execução contra vários provedores de CFD associados a estruturas operacionais complexas no exterior, reforçando os padrões de conformidade para empresas que atendem clientes domésticos.

As corretoras também estão adaptando sua infraestrutura tecnológica e se expandindo para setores adjacentes. A eToro avançou na transição de seus clientes em direção a um aplicativo de negociação centrado em inteligência artificial, enquanto a Capital.com preparou o terreno para uma operação dedicada de ativos digitais no Reino Unido.

No entanto, os ventos contrários do mercado continuam a impactar alguns participantes da indústria. A BlackBull Markets optou por adiar seus planos de oferta pública inicial (IPO), e a iFOREX divulgou resultados financeiros revelando um prejuízo líquido no primeiro metade do ano.

Esses desenvolvimentos sublinham uma indústria em transição, onde as corretoras tradicionais devem equilibrar as pressões regulatórias com a inovação rápida. À medida que mais entidades estabelecidas lançam iniciativas de prop trading, os traders de varejo podem esperar uma integração ainda maior entre contas de corretagem padrão e modelos de financiamento.
